answer_1.quote: We test our model on two popular Chinese conversational datasets weibo and douban.

answer_2.quote: Metrics which measure the word-level overlap like BLEU have been widely used for dialogue evaluation... We measure the diversity by the ratio of distinct unigrams (Dist-1) and bigrams (Dist-2)... We also report the entropy of four-grams (Ent-4)... We also evaluate the relevance by leveraging an adversarial discriminator.

answer_4.quote: We also employed crowdsourced judges to evaluate the quality of generations for 500 contexts of each dataset.
answer_4.guideline: We focus on evaluating the generated responses regarding the (1) relevance: if they coincide with the context (Rel), (2) interestingness: if they are interesting for people to continue the conversation (Inter) and (3) fluency: whether they are fluent by grammar (Flu).
